newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly firmer in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly firmer in quiet trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly higher against the U.S. dollar in muted pre-weekend trade on Friday and dealers said they expected a quiet market to continue in the near term.
The rate finished at T$27.491 compared with Thursday's T$27.492 close. Turnover was a slow US$162.5 million.
Some players stepped to the sidelines due to the quietness in overseas markets, dealers said.
"There is some expectation for foreign equity fund inflows, but there seem to be no major entries in the near term," said one dealer. A T$27.46-52 range was seen. --Joyce Liu (5080815)
